cases.fixture_purpose: the ADR-0055 two-net crossing topology, reproduced as a neutral control
six nets under a penalty that forces multi-iteration negotiation
the same six nets under a penalty the first pass already resolves

claim.rule: no slot combination is asserted better than the ADR-0055 default. The sweep was not predeclared, the three fixtures are small and synthetic, and no held-out corpus was used. A quality claim requires a criterion declared before measurement on fixtures reserved for it.

declared_plans.name: no-plan-baseline
declared_plans.rationale: the ADR-0055 coordinator with no declared plan; the comparison baseline

declared_plans.name: legacy-equivalent
declared_plans.rationale: the default plan, declared to reproduce the ADR-0055 strategy

declared_plans.name: net-order/stable-identifier
declared_plans.rationale: a fixed `(net_id, seed)` order on every pass, ignoring conflict feedback

declared_plans.name: net-order/demand-descending
declared_plans.rationale: longest-demand-first, the classic 'route the hard nets first' heuristic

declared_plans.name: cost-update/scaled-accumulation-4
declared_plans.rationale: history accumulates four integer units per overuse instead of one

declared_plans.name: cost-update/saturating-decay-half
declared_plans.rationale: history halves each pass before accumulating, so stale congestion ages out

declared_plans.name: cost-update/present-growth-13-10
declared_plans.rationale: a growing present-sharing factor, the shape of a VPR-style pres_fac schedule

declared_plans.name: rip-up/conflicted-only
declared_plans.rationale: retain every net that holds no conflict instead of ripping up everything

declared_plans.name: rip-up/top-conflict-2
declared_plans.rationale: rip up at most the two most conflicted retained nets

declared_plans.name: composed/conflicted-only+present-growth
declared_plans.rationale: two slots moved at once, to show the composition is not additive

non_claims: candidate geometry is not applied to a board
no model output or model-generated copper is used
the bounded physical-clearance count is not KiCad DRC
no manufacturing, fabrication, or board-mutation claim
via counts are structurally zero because the coordinator is single-layer
no general-board, corpus, or scaling result
